I was born in Birchills, and this was my GP until I moved in December 2025, when I was told I had to look for a new GP because it was out of the area. At the time, I was so annoyed because I was still living in my old home, but it turned out to be a blessing in disguise. I have been having back issues, cloudy urine, and bowel issues for over 6 months. I knew deep down I wasn't having UTI issues, but something more severe. We have a family history of chronic pancreatitis, and every time I went into the office, I kept telling them this, which they kept saying had nothing to do with my pancreas, even though I went private for an abdominal scan, and he picked up a fatty pancreas. The doctor I went to before leaving literally said, “Back pain has nothing to do with the pancreas,” which was very concerning. She said, “It sounds like I have spine issues”, even though I kept telling her, all these symptoms came together in June! The doctor, even before her, literally goes, “This is no pancreas issue, bowel changes have nothing to do with your pancreas,” Which is not true! They kept neglecting my concerns because of “what they thought was right”, not what was actually right! Could have at least googled it! I remember telling her that my private ultrasound picked up a fatty pancreas and that I had an email of my results. As I was literally searching my emails for 10 seconds, she goes, “Well, I'm still waiting.” Her tone was abrupt, and I knew I was in the worst hands possible.

They would not check my pancreas or give me any blood tests, as they didn't think anything was wrong with me. And kept saying, “Oh, you had a blood test on so and so month, and everything looked fine,” which, in fact, was untrue. My blood test was abnormal. My crp was high, and other things were out of normal range.  Finally, I went to my new GP, literally on the first appointment, he goes, “This sounds like there's an issue with your pancreas. I will be booking you in for a blood test, taking a stool sample, and I will be getting in contact with the gastro team” he said this without even me letting him know about my family history. The fact that he can also confirm what I've been worried about all this time is true, but because of the lack of care from this place, my situation most likely is far worse than we believe.

If you can find another GP, please, please do. This GP does not care about your welfare. They want to keep fobbing you off.
